provider_application_setup_guide_ack_che.name: provider_application_setup_guide_ack_check
provider_application_setup_guide_ack_che.value:
("provider_application_setup"."service_guide_version" IS NULL AND "provider_application_setup"."service_guide_acknowledged_at" IS NULL)
      OR ("provider_application_setup"."service_guide_version" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_application_setup"."service_guide_acknowledged_at" IS NOT NULL)

provider_application_setup_service_area_.name: provider_application_setup_service_area_check
provider_application_setup_service_area_.value:
"provider_application_setup"."service_area_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR (
      "provider_application_setup"."service_area_region" IS NOT NULL
      AND btrim("provider_application_setup"."service_area_region") <> ''
      AND "provider_application_setup"."service_area_zip_codes" IS NOT NULL
      AND cardinality("provider_application_setup"."service_area_zip_codes") > 0
      AND array_to_string("provider_application_setup"."service_area_zip_codes", ',') ~ '^[0-9]{5}(,[0-9]{5})*$'
      AND "provider_application_setup"."max_travel_radius" BETWEEN 5 AND 50
    )

provider_application_setup_training_chec.name: provider_application_setup_training_check
provider_application_setup_training_chec.value:
("provider_application_setup"."training_completed_at" IS NULL AND "provider_application_setup"."training_completed_by" IS NULL)
      OR ("provider_application_setup"."training_completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "provider_application_setup"."training_completed_by" IS NOT NULL)
